name: Claims Lodgement Officer completes claim and ends call

chat_history.message: I'd like to lodge a vehicle claim please.
It's registration ABC-123, policy number POL-123456.
I was rear-ended at a red light on the 3rd of March at 2pm, at the corner of Smith and King Street.
You can reach me by email at john.smith@example.com. My name is John Smith.
Perfect, thank you. Is there another claim you'd like to lodge today?

success_condition: All required vehicle claim fields have now been provided, the claimant has confirmed the spelling of their name, and the claimant has just confirmed there is no other claim to lodge (multiple-claims rule) — nothing is missing and nothing further is pending. The agent should tell the claimant something equivalent to 'I've recorded your details. Our team will be in touch within two business days.' and then call end_call. The agent must NOT say the claim has been lodged, must NOT mention a claim number, and must NOT promise an email confirmation — none of that exists in this flow. The agent must not continue asking for fields that have already been provided, must not ask about another claim again (the claimant already answered no), and must not mention transferring or a supervisor.

success_examples.response: Thanks John, I've got everything I need. I've recorded your details, and our team will be in touch within two business days.
Perfect, thank you John. I've recorded all your details — our team will reach out to you within two business days. Take care.

failure_examples.response: I've lodged your claim. Expect an email within 1 business day with your claim number.
Your claim has been lodged. You'll receive your claim number by email shortly.
Could you please provide your policy number?
One moment, let me transfer you to my supervisor.
